symptom: `mxcli check` warns MDL-WIDGET07 "property `showFooter` is not recognized and will be silently dropped on write" on a dataview, yet `exec` writes it and `describe page` emits `ShowFooter: true` — so re-executing describe's own output warns too. Same false warning for `Menu:` / `Profile:` / `Orientation:` on navigationtree / menubar and `SizeMode:` on a scroll-container `region`
cause: `staticWidgetKnownProps` (the MDL-WIDGET07 allow-list) is hand-maintained, and its drift guard `TestStaticWidgetKnownPropsCoverDescribe` was a second hand-typed list. #813 added the builder read (`lookupPropCI(w, "ShowFooter")`) and the describe emission but neither list
insight: Replace the hand-typed guard with a source scan: `go/parser` over `cmd_pages_builder*.go` for `Get*Prop("K")`, `lookupPropCI(w, "K")` and `Properties["K"]`, plus the `"K: "` strings in `cmd_pages_describe_output.go`. Its first run found the reported key and four more nobody had reported (SizeMode is used by a checked-in example, `bug-tests/573-simple-menu-bar.mdl`). The only exclusions are `ImageUrlParams` / `AlternativeTextParams`, emitted solely for the PLUGGABLE `image` widget, which MDL-WIDGET01 validates — probing with `staticimage` instead of `image` made them look like false positives too. Issue #1346
